title: On Establishing a school in the north street
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：establish　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 establish 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the planner ① established a school in the north street without complaint, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② establishes a school in the north street with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ establish a school in the north street at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ established a school in the north street before — a line in the report for March 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Establishing a school in the north street without complaint, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ establish the custom within two years with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Establish the custom within two years at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ establishes the custom within two years without complaint every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ established a school in the north street again when nobody else would.

⑩ To establish a school in the north street, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody establishes a school in the north street with great care again and somebody must establish a school in the north street without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 建立（一般过去式 established a school in the north street：1993 年规划员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 建立（一般现在 establishes a school in the north street：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 建立（不定式 to establish a school in the north street：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 建立（过去完成时 had established a school in the north street：1987 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 建立（动名词 establishing a school in the north street 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 确立（establish the custom within two years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去确立两年里把那习俗确立下来）
G. v. 确立（establish the custom within two years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 建立（后段两处：新来的市民照例 establishes the custom within two years，而母亲又一次 established a school in the north street）

answers.why: establish 意为“建立”，1993 年规划员毫无怨言地建立在北街办起一所学堂，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 established。
establish 意为“建立”，自那以后规划员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 establishes。
establish 意为“建立”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯建立在北街办起一所学堂”，此处为不定式 to establish a school in the north street。
establish 意为“建立”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人建立过，故用过去完成时 had established。
establish 意为“建立”，规划员说“建立在北街办起一所学堂这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 establishing a school in the north street 作主语。
establish 意为“确立”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去确立两年里把那习俗确立下来”，should ever 之后用原形 establish the custom within two years。
establish 意为“确立”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻确立两年里把那习俗确立下来（establish the custom within two years at once），以后再也不要提起。
establish 意为“建立”，新来的市民每个年份都照例确立两年里把那习俗确立下来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 establishes。
establish 意为“建立”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地建立在北街办起一所学堂，用一般过去式 established 叙述。
establish 意为“建立”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要建立在北街办起一所学堂，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 establish 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the planner established a school in the north street without complaint, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner establishes a school in the north street with great care whenever the district asks.
Establishing a school in the north street without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever establish the custom within two years with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district establishes the custom within two years without complaint every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother established a school in the north street again, and the district remembered that half.
